findings.summary: slots_setstate assumes dict state, so old tuple-format pickles from earlier attrs versions silently skip all attributes (or raise TypeError) with no tuple fallback.

For a slotted cache_hash=True class with no attributes, the empty (falsy) dict state means __setstate__ is not called, so _hash_cache_field is never reset to None (reviewer is unsure and asks to verify).
New unpickle tests only cover dict-to-dict loading and none load an old tuple-format pickle, so the backward-compat bug would go unnoticed.
@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls", [A]) is pointless since it only ever passes the single module-level A.
A module-level class named A risks name collisions with other names in the test file.
